scripts.test:unit: cargo test --locked --manifest-path network-contracts/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path network-agent/Cargo.toml
scripts.tauri:android:init: tauri android init --ci --config src-tauri/tauri.android.conf.json && npm run configure:android
scripts.tauri:android:dev: npm run configure:android && tauri android dev --config src-tauri/tauri.android.conf.json
scripts.tauri:android:build: npm run configure:android && tauri android build --config src-tauri/tauri.android.conf.json
scripts.tauri:ios:init: tauri ios init --ci --config src-tauri/tauri.mobile.conf.json && npm run configure:ios
scripts.tauri:ios:dev: npm run configure:ios && tauri ios dev --config src-tauri/tauri.mobile.conf.json
scripts.tauri:ios:build: npm run configure:ios && tauri ios build --config src-tauri/tauri.mobile.conf.json
scripts.check:ios:vpn: npm run configure:ios && xcodebuild -project src-tauri/gen/apple/noland-connect.xcodeproj -scheme NolandPacketTunnelOnly -configuration debug -sdk iphonesimulator -arch arm64 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO build
